_comment: Golden values. Every gate compares against THIS file. Tolerances are fixed here and may never be widened in code. Verified three independent ways: float halfspace construction, exact sympy certificates, and scipy/qhull cross-implementation.
theorem: eta = 36*pi*V^2/S^3 = Q_iso, valid iff every Voronoi neighbour is a contact; equivalently S = d*V/R (proved as exact identity)

tangential_bravais_3d.no_14_face_solution: all seven Selling class norms equal forces p_ij=1/6 giving norms 1/2 and 2/3

fcc_depletion_ladder.formula: eta_K = 2*sqrt2*pi/(12+K) = (z0/(z0+K))*eta_cp, K deleted nn per particle
fcc_depletion_ladder.independence_is_forced: divacancy in FCC gives face-distance spread 0.4142 (= sqrt2 - 1) in adjacent cells; isolated vacancy gives 0

family_2d.spectral_bound: K <= 3 because triangular Bloch band = [-3, 6]; the once-claimed phi=0.453450 rung (K=6, z=0) is RETRACTED

tri_6x6_K2.note: 3 non-coset orbits; every cell of every solution exactly tangential with Q = sqrt3*pi/8

tet_oct.error: 8 adjacent tetrahedra, not 2; cell reduces to rhombic dodecahedron

berthier_witten_pre80_021502.warning: 2-3 sig figs, avoided/extrapolated fits, system-dependent (Brambilla: 0.637); never cite sub-1e-3 agreement as evidence

engine_gates.calibration: 2.2% fractional sem at 12 configs, N=504; 1% feature at 3 sigma needs ~510
